message:
Running command: cd /workspace && bash build.sh 'cd /work && python3 -c "
import struct
# Create a 200x100 PGM image
w, h = 200, 100
with open(\"/work/test.pgm\", \"wb\") as f:
    f.write(b\"P5\\n%d %d\\n255\\n\" % (w, h))
    f.write(bytes([128]) * (w*h))
print(\"PGM created\")
" && /work/src/build/bin/opj_compress -i /work/test.pgm -o /work/test2tile.j2k -t 100,100 2>&1 | tail -5 && python3 -c "
data = open(\"/work/test2tile.j2k\",\"rb\").read()
print(\"size\", len(data))
print(data.hex())
"' 2>&1 | tail -10

message.content: The encoder is built. Now let me create a valid 2-tile codestream. Let me create a PGM image and compress it with 2 tiles.
